quoted_tweet.text:
As I’ve said, my military service was essential to who I am as a human being. The challenges, the people, the mission, the miserable days, the risks. It was all supremely instrumental and shaped me.

It wasn’t all hardship, though! It was also the experience of a lifetime! Some of the coolest places/experiences I captured in my travels:

Flying into the Northern Lights in the middle of the night
Grabbing a water taxi in Venice, Italy
Flying around Ayers Rock, Australia, at about 100 feet
Watching the sun set on Kwajalein Atoll
Watching Mount Aetna erupt from my hotel room
Diving the Great Barrier Reef in Australia
Walking the Roman Forum
Attending an Egyptian wedding in Cairo
Hiking to the bottom of the Grand Canyon
Riding a camel at the Pyramids at Giza
Spending the night in a safari lodge in Kenya, Africa 
The Taj Mahal
Handing out soccer balls to kids in Baghdad
A public train in Tokyo with “people pushers”
Flying over London at night with a thousand lights below 
Mount Kilimanjaro 
Arriving in Sydney at dawn and flying over the Opera House

Military service definitely isn’t for everybody. But it was for me!🇺🇸
